summary: Disk-cache tiers left by earlier images are reported at startup and can be pruned
compatibility: No user action required. Set LMCACHE_L2_PRUNE_STALE=1 to delete unused tiers of earlier images at startup.
details: A new image or a changed cache setting starts a new LMCache disk tier, and the previous tier stayed on disk outside LMCACHE_L2_GB. One production deployment found about 530 GB per host this way.

The startup log now lists such tiers of the same model with their sizes. With LMCACHE_L2_PRUNE_STALE=1 they are deleted at startup, except tiers held by a running container and tiers written in the last 30 minutes.
